context: A flag default overrides the config file

checklist.name: cause
checklist.description: Explains that `Set` is the highest-precedence layer, so copying the flag's value (including its unchanged default) into it beats env and the file.

checklist.name: bind_pflag
checklist.description: Replaces the copy with `v.BindPFlag("server.port", cmd.Flags().Lookup("port"))`, checks its error, and puts the default in `SetDefault`, so the flag only wins when the user typed it.

checklist.name: env_binding
checklist.description: Binds the env name with a prefix and key replacer (or `BindEnv`) so `APP_SERVER_PORT` maps to `server.port`.

checklist.name: read_after_parse
checklist.description: Reads the effective value from Viper or the decoded struct after flag parsing, not from the flag variable.

checklist.name: tests
checklist.description: Tests default, file, env over file, and typed flag over env with a fresh Viper instance and command tree per case, clearing the env variable where it should be absent.
